subject: gov.policy
name: Burundi Large Bande 2025 broadband strategy
status: In development, validated and not adopted
milestone: Validated by stakeholders 6 December 2017, en instance d'adoption par le Gouvernement
position_end: Still awaiting government adoption; no published text and no adopting act located

subject: gov.policy
name: Draft law on access to public information
status: In development, adopted in Council of Ministers
milestone: Adopted in Council of Ministers 10 June 2026
position_end: A draft adopted in Council and not enacted; no text published and no parliamentary date set

subject: gov.policy
name: National broadband mapping system
milestone: National Africa-BB-Maps event, Bujumbura, 28-30 October 2025
position_end: A national broadband mapping system established under regulator stewardship with an operational roadmap, to identify underserved areas and direct investment

subject: gov.policy
name: National Data Governance Strategy
milestone: Validated with seven pillars, UNECA-supported and AU Data Policy Framework-aligned
position_end: Validated; treats data as a public good

subject: gov.policy
name: Plan directeur de digitalisation des services publics 2023-2033
milestone: Adopted in Council of Ministers 2023-05-10; mid-term review of the financing project, March 2026
position_end: In force as the standing digitalisation instrument, with an implementation roadmap agreed in November 2025 and the World Bank project financing it reviewed at mid-term in March 2026

subject: gov.policy
name: Politique nationale de developpement des TIC 2010-2025
milestone: Adopted in Council of Ministers 13 July 2011 for a term to 2025
position_end: Term expired at the end of 2025 with no adopted successor located

subject: gov.policy
name: Proposed mobile-phone ban for civil servants
milestone: Proposed by the president, office landlines to replace mobile phones
position_end: Proposed; no instrument on file

subject: gov.policy
name: Rules restricting cross-border data transfer
milestone: Absence stated in a regional digital-trade regulatory profile
position_end: No national legal framework on cross-border data transfers and no measure restricting them, including on data location, transfer bans or local processing
note: the finding is a stated absence rather than a gap in the record; the profile's underlying regulatory survey runs to December 2021

subject: gov.policy
name: Vision 2040-2060 sector implementation documents
milestone: Prime Minister's orientation workshop, 3 July 2026
position_end: Ministries instructed to produce implementation documents, with public-administration digitalisation and e-government among the first priority programmes; no document published

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access to information bill
milestone: Listed on the National Assembly's order paper for the session opened 3 August 2026
position_end: Scheduled for examination; no text, tabling number, sponsoring ministry or timetable published
note: The session runs about three months under article 176 of the constitution, the outer bound for passage in this sitting.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing regime
milestone: Five central bank circulars issued, FATF-aligned
position_end: Five circulars in force

subject: gov.legislate
name: Decret n 100/085 du 25 juillet 2018 portant cadre national des donnees
milestone: Presidential decree of 25 July 2018
position_end: In force as the closest instrument to legislation enabling data sharing between public bodies: it defines administrative data, brings it into the dissemination regime and provides for making data available electronically

subject: gov.legislate
name: Dedicated artificial-intelligence legislation
milestone: No loi, decret, ordonnance or regulator reglement on artificial intelligence located, November 2025
position_end: No binding instrument; what moved in the window is the validation of a non-binding national strategy
note: a dated, searched absence: the November 2025 readiness assessment is the authoritative Burundi-specific statement of it

subject: gov.legislate
name: Guidelines for the national electronic-commerce sector and the conformity declaration
milestone: Guidelines published 29 May 2026; conformity declaration made compulsory 26 June 2026
position_end: Guidelines setting technical, operational and organisational standards for interoperability, transaction security and consumer protection, followed by a compulsory prior conformity declaration for platforms and merchant sites

subject: gov.legislate
name: Instituting texts for the Fichier National d'Identification
milestone: Stated on the official procedure page that further texts remain to be adopted
position_end: The national identification file has a procedure page and no instituting instrument; further texts remain to be adopted

subject: gov.legislate
name: Law regulating social-media influencers and content creators
milestone: Consultation workshop held 2026-08-26
position_start: No dedicated legal framework for online publishing
position_end: Consultations opened on 26 August 2026, the communication ministry convening influencers, content creators, legal experts and jurists to gather sector input before the bill is finalised; it would be the country's first dedicated legal framework for online publishing
note: no draft provisions are published, and whether the law would require registration, set disclosure rules for sponsored content, create an oversight body or set penalties is unestablished

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi n 1/07 du 11 mai 2018 portant systeme national de paiement
milestone: Framework statute of 2018; oversight framework and the national instant payment system built under it
position_end: The framework statute is in force, its articles 22 to 24 carrying the move of payment instruments off paper and the admissibility of electronic evidence, and the central bank has published an oversight framework and launched a national instant payment system under it

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi n 1/08 du 20 mai 2021 sur l'organisation du systeme statistique
milestone: Recast of the 2007 statistics law, promulgated 20 May 2021
position_end: In force as the substantive recast in a chain running from the 2007 law through this one to a 2023 modification, for which no gazetted text was located

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi n 1/10 du 16 mars 2022 sur la cybercriminalite
milestone: Promulgated 16 March 2022, recorded En vigueur on the official legal database
position_end: In force as the stand-alone cybercrime statute, alongside the cybersecurity obligations at articles 160 to 167 of the 2024 electronic communications code

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi n 1/22 du 22 aout 2024 portant code des communications electroniques et postales
milestone: Promulgated 22 August 2024
position_end: In force and treated by the regulator as the legal basis for electronic commerce; there is no free-standing electronic transactions or electronic signature law

subject: gov.legislate
name: Ordonnance ministerielle n 540/906/2026 on SIM registration
milestone: Non-compliant lines deactivated from 25 June 2026
position_end: Every subscriber required to regularise identification against the national identity card, with deactivation of non-compliant lines from 25 June 2026

subject: gov.protect
name: ARCT injunctions on value-added-service consent
milestone: Injunctions issued to Lumitel requiring genuinely voluntary subscription and prior notification
position_end: Issued; the consumer association reports no significant improvement two months on, and no sanction is on file
note: Lumitel maintains that nothing activates without a customer's deliberate action.

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection authority
milestone: Created by the January 2026 law; no appointment, budget or decision on file
position_end: Provided for by statute; not on record as operating

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-sharing agreement under the United States health-sector memorandum
position_end: None published

subject: gov.protect
name: Loi n 1/03 du 10 mars 2026 portant protection des donnees a caractere personnel
milestone: Promulgated 10 March 2026, published by the regulator 18 March 2026
position_start: No legal regime for personal-data processing in Burundian positive law
position_end: A first personal data protection law promulgated; the official text is an image-only scan, so its provisions cannot be read from the base

subject: gov.protect
name: Personal data protection law
milestone: Unanimously adopted by the National Assembly, 15 January 2026
position_end: In force: eight chapters, an independent authority, criminal penalties, Malabo-aligned
note: The government's stated sequencing is that legislation came first in order to enable the biometric identity card.

subject: gov.regional
name: AfCFTA country implementation roadmap
milestone: Technical team agreed 3 August 2026, during the AfCFTA Secretary-General's mission to Bujumbura, to produce a country profile and implementation roadmap jointly owned by government and the private sector
position_end: Agreed at ministerial level; no roadmap, country profile or timetable published
note: Minister tied the effort to Burundi's African Union Chairmanship; discussion also covered the AfCFTA Adjustment Fund, to which Burundi was urged to submit financing priorities

subject: gov.regional
name: EAC One Network Area and Regional Digital Integration protocol
milestone: Joined the One Network Area and ratified the protocol
position_end: Joined and ratified

subject: gov.regional
name: IGAD cross-border health security cooperation
milestone: Consultation on a memorandum held in Bujumbura, August 2026
position_end: A consultation on a cross-border health-security memorandum has been held under a World Bank-supported regional programme; nothing is signed and no data-sharing arrangement is on file

subject: gov.regional
name: Regional submarine cable access and cross-border interconnection
milestone: Regional digital single market position endorsed at the East African D4D forum, 23-24 June 2026
position_end: Submarine cable access to EASSy, SEACOM and TEAMS through neighbouring countries, cross-border fibre interconnection with Rwanda, the DRC and Tanzania, and regional roaming, with a harmonised roaming framework under development

subject: gov.regional
name: Vietnam-Burundi telecommunications-technology memorandum
milestone: Implementation meeting held 28 July 2026, party-to-party rather than ministry-to-ministry
position_start: Signed November 2024, no digital follow-through reported
position_end: Policy transfer, 50 desktop computer sets and Master's scholarships reported; no monetary commitment

subject: gov.standards
name: Common technical standards for health information exchange
milestone: National health information workshop, 7-10 April 2026
position_end: Common technical standards defined, HL7 FHIR named, with priority data-exchange flows and mediation for the fragmented health platforms

subject: gov.standards
name: Concept type des systemes d'information des institutions publiques
milestone: Final document presented for validation 17 December 2024
position_end: Presented for validation as the foundation of digitalisation and the route to adopting international ICT standards; presentation for validation, not formal adoption

subject: gov.standards
name: EMIS self-assessment against African Union norms and standards
milestone: Three-day technical workshop in Bujumbura, June 2026
position_end: The education management information system assessed by Burundi itself against the continental EMIS norms and standards; no score or action plan published

subject: gov.standards
name: Harmonised East African standards adopted
milestone: 628 of 690 harmonised standards adopted, 91 per cent, to June 2023
position_end: 628 of 690 harmonised East African standards adopted and 62 not adopted, the highest adoption rate of the six partner states

subject: gov.standards
name: Migration of the automated transfer system to ISO 20022
milestone: Migration completed 5 February 2026, interbank operations resuming on the new system 6 February
position_end: The national automated transfer system migrated to the international messaging standard, stated to ease integration with regional and international settlement systems

subject: gov.standards
name: National technical standards or interoperability framework
milestone: No national framework on file; the standards work on record is regional
position_end: Not held

subject: gov.standards
name: Politique Nationale Qualite
milestone: Adopted in Council of Ministers 2 February 2022
position_end: Adopted as the base instrument for establishing and supervising the national quality infrastructure system, with objectives, roadmap and timetable

subject: gov.standards
name: Standardisation and conformity protocol with the Congolese control office
milestone: Memorandum signed in Bujumbura 29 August 2025
position_end: Exchange of information on standards, metrology and conformity assessment with progressive mutual recognition of conformity certificates; no official text of the protocol located

subject: gov.discourse
name: Central Africa Internet Governance Forum, Bujumbura
milestone: Held 16-21 February 2026 at the Palais des Congres de Kigobe
position_end: Hosted for the first time, with eleven Central African countries and government, youth, women, private-sector and technical participants, and a 2026 regional roadmap validated

subject: gov.discourse
name: Documented government internet controls
milestone: Two decades of controls mapped in a civil-society study, 1999-2019
position_end: Internet controls, surveillance, restrictive media regulation and censorship of a named outlet documented to 2019, against civil-society resistance

subject: gov.discourse
name: Etats generaux de la communication
milestone: Proposed by the consumer association ABUCO; no convening date on file
position_end: Proposed; no response from government or operators on file

subject: finance.budget
name: Communications and ICT ministry vote
milestone: Reported in the FY2024/25 loi de reglement

subject: finance.budget
name: Execution discipline of voted appropriations
milestone: Mid-year work-plan report showed credits shifted between programmes with a 2.7% overrun
position_end: Credits shifted between programmes; a voted line does not reliably execute

subject: finance.budget
name: General state budget
milestone: FY2026/27 budget adopted unanimously by the National Assembly
position_end: Expenditure above BIF 7,020bn against revenue of BIF 6,296.03bn, up 23.76%
note: The Cour des comptes told senators the bill lacked clarity on total public debt remaining and on the effects of new measures.

subject: finance.budget
name: Whole-budget revenue realisation
milestone: FY2024/25 loi de reglement adopted 13 May 2026
position_end: BIF 3,234bn realised, 76.79% of the revised target

subject: finance.mou
name: United States health-sector memorandum
milestone: Five-year agreement signed, including health-data management
position_end: US$156m over five years

subject: finance.new
name: Non-state capital committed to network build
milestone: USD 5,907,000 contract signed 29 April 2026 to serve 92 uncovered collines
position_start: An operator stated to have decided to double its investment to meet customer demand, with no absolute amount and no baseline published
position_end: Two co-financed rural connectivity contracts: USD 10 million split 44 per cent government and 56 per cent operator, and USD 5,907,000 to serve 92 collines with no 2G or 3G coverage, benefiting 372,035 people including schools and health facilities

subject: finance.new
name: PAFEN Digital Foundations Project
milestone: Mid-term review put commitment at 61%
position_end: 61% committed; priorities are public-finance modernisation, the national identity card and a national data centre

subject: infra.connect
name: Burundi national internet exchange point
milestone: Created by decret n 100/122 of 13 May 2014
position_end: Established by decree as the exchange point belonging to the Republic, its first stated objective keeping local traffic off international links, its management placed with an ISP association chosen and authorised by the regulator
note: no traffic, membership or uptime figure for the exchange is held

subject: infra.connect
name: Fibre optic deployed by infrastructure operator
milestone: Regulator statistics as at 31 December 2024
position_end: 1,750 km on the national backbone covering all provinces, 350 km of metropolitan network in the capital and 3,400 km on the third operator's network, with the regulator stating the national territory is now covered by fibre

subject: infra.connect
name: Fonds de service universel institutional connectivity
milestone: FY2026/27 revised appropriation of BIF 11.40bn for dedicated IP transit to health facilities and schools
position_end: BIF 11.40bn revised, own-source levy, FY2026/27

subject: infra.connect
name: Governance of the national backbone concessionaire
milestone: Director general appointed 9 April 2026 and state administrators named 13 April 2026
position_end: The mixed-economy company holding the concession to operate the national fibre infrastructure has a new director general and a reconstituted state representation on its board, under the finance and digital economy ministry

subject: infra.connect
name: ICT infrastructure-sharing law
milestone: Named by the regulator as a draft law; no text published
position_end: In draft; no text, tabling date or sponsoring ministry published

subject: infra.connect
name: International capacity through neighbouring landings
milestone: Regulator indicators report, edition 2020
position_end: Landlocked access to EASSy, SEACOM and TEAMS through neighbouring countries, over cross-border interconnection points with Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Tanzania; no capacity figure in Gbps is published

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet use and mobile coverage
milestone: Regulator quarterly market observatory for the fourth quarter of 2025
position_start: 12.5 per cent of Burundians using the internet in early 2025, against 3G reaching 50 to 54 per cent of the population and 4G 32 to 34 per cent
position_end: The regulator's own subscription-based series is published quarterly; a fifth-generation network launched commercially in December 2025 with 80 sites while a large majority of the population remains offline

subject: infra.connect
name: Mobile and internet network quality
milestone: Regulator published its own diagnosis of degraded quality and named six causes
position_start: Outages attributed to power, fuel and foreign-exchange shortages (2025-09)
position_end: Degraded; ARCT names power cuts, generator fuel supply, unstable REGIDESO supply, urban bandwidth saturation, ageing transmission equipment and missing masts

subject: infra.connect
name: PAFEN mast-deployment programme
milestone: Named by the regulator as financed and in train
position_end: Financed and in train; addresses coverage rather than outages

subject: infra.connect
name: PAFEN rural 4G build
milestone: ONATEL contracted for 92 hills after Lumitel's contract for 86
position_end: Lumitel >US$10m for 86 hills across 14 provinces; ONATEL US$5.9m for 92 hills covering 372,035 people

subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink licence
milestone: Licensed but effectively unavailable on cost, the kit alone at roughly US$500
position_end: Licensed, unaffordable

subject: infra.store
name: Data centre estate
milestone: Agency-level procurement of racks and stabilisers, February 2026
position_start: No shared government data centre; the revenue office, the central bank and the presidency each running their own, one level-3 facility built for USD 2 million and about four data centres of decent grade in the country
position_end: Still no shared government facility on the record; capacity is being added agency by agency, a development agency tendering for data centre racks, stabilisers and projectors for its own facility

subject: infra.store
name: National data centre
milestone: Named a PAFEN mid-term priority alongside public-finance modernisation and the national ID
position_end: A stated PAFEN priority; no build, site or date on file

subject: infra.store
name: Off-site backup and continuity capacity
milestone: Re-issued tender for virtualisation and backup equipment at the state technology secretariat, April 2026
position_end: The central bank operates and maintains a physically separate alternative site, and the state technology secretariat is procuring additional virtualisation and backup equipment and licences for the body hosting national platforms
note: neither source states IT capacity, rack count or replication arrangement

subject: infra.energy
name: Generation and transmission serving the capital
milestone: Mulembwe dam commissioned 16 June 2026; 30 kV reinforcement contract signed 17 June 2026
position_start: Installed capacity of 204.882 MW and outages leaving businesses paralysed, hospitals on generators and industry on costly gensets
position_end: A 17 MW hydropower dam commissioned, completing a 49.5 MW complex, a transformer substation connected allowing up to 50 MW into the capital's network, and a nationwide 30 kV reinforcement contract awarded

subject: infra.energy
name: Powering of mobile base stations
milestone: Study planned by the regulator; no instrument or programme
position_end: At study stage, against a network the regulator says fails mainly on electricity

subject: infra.energy
name: Rural electrification and access rate
milestone: Rural electrification agency's account of its 2025-2026 financial year
position_start: An access rate of 25.9 per cent, 8 per cent on the interconnected grid and 17.9 per cent on decentralised solutions, against a target of 70 per cent by 2030
position_end: Ten named rural centres electrified during the year with works continuing at seven more, alongside maintenance of solar mini-grids and micro-hydro plants

subject: infra.capacity
name: Compute or high-performance computing capacity
milestone: No source on file
position_end: Not held

subject: infra.capacity
name: Government network, servers and shared services
milestone: Tax platform entered service 4 August 2026; integrated public financial management system tendered March 2026
position_start: A government network providing about 55 public institutions with 2.5 Mbps broadband, a small network operations centre and data centre, fragmented ministry servers and no national data-exchange layer
position_end: A cross-government financial management system out to tender and a revenue platform in production, with the government network position itself unrestated since 2022

subject: infra.capacity
name: Local capacity to run central government systems
milestone: Change-management workshop for the financial management system opened 7 April 2026
position_start: The digital ministry, the state technology secretariat and the regulator all stated to require technical assistance
position_end: A change-management workshop preparing public administration teams to adopt and run the financial management system, which is appropriation of a central state system rather than its procurement; no staffing, certification or retention figure is published

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Regional financial-system cybersecurity measures
milestone: EAC central bank governors flagged the risk as requiring stronger common measures
position_end: Flagged by the governors; no common measure adopted

subject: dpi.exchange
name: EAC cross-border secure data-sharing framework
milestone: Validated in Dar es Salaam under the East Africa Regional Digital Integration Project
position_end: Validated; no national implementing instrument on file

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Education management information system interoperability
milestone: Self-assessment against continental EMIS norms, June 2026
position_start: Paper collection at the school followed by electronic entry at central level, with limits on integration and reliability of the databases
position_end: Ministry cadres trained in database administration and the system assessed against continental norms and standards; no integration with any other national system is stated

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Health information system interoperability
milestone: Laboratory information system deployed to nine sites, 18-29 May 2026
position_start: Health platforms coexisting without automatic transfer, with feeding between the clinical and reporting systems done manually
position_end: Common technical standards defined at a national workshop with HL7 FHIR named, and a laboratory information system put into nine strategic sites interconnecting ten diagnostic instruments to a central platform with automated data transmission

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Identity verification by financial and telecom systems
milestone: SIM identification against the identity card compulsory from 25 June 2026
position_start: National identity cards presented as documentary evidence at account opening rather than authenticated against a register
position_end: Documentary identity verification extended across the supervised financial sector by regulation and circular, and made compulsory for every SIM; no query against a central identity register is described in either

subject: dpi.exchange
name: National data exchange layer
milestone: No national data-exchange layer recorded in the government's own project appraisal
position_end: Ministry servers fragmented with no national data-exchange layer; the 2018 data framework decree provides the legal basis and no platform operates on it
note: a dated statement of absence in the government's own financing document, not a gap in the record

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Social protection information system integration
milestone: More than a million beneficiary records migrated to the shared platform
position_start: A management information system migrated to a shared platform hosted in the government data centre, with an interfacing architecture supporting identity integration but no confirmed live link
position_end: More than a million individual beneficiary records migrated, the system connected to several payment providers and its extension to the unified social registry prepared

subject: dpi.id
name: Biometric national identity card
milestone: Unveiled as technically ready but awaiting the law or decree governing its use
position_start: Confirmed not ready for the 2025 voter enrolment
position_end: Technically ready, awaiting a legal instrument; piloted in about a dozen communes
sources: 2026-05-07-burundi-unveils-biometric-national-id-awaits-law|2024-05-24 Burundi - biometric national ID card will not be available for 2025 voter enrolment
note: Whole-project cost put at about BIF 15bn, covering equipment, production centres and nationwide deployment.

subject: dpi.id
name: Birth registration and birth-certificate coverage (UNICEF)
milestone: Cited by government on Africa Civil Registration Day (10 August 2026); UNICEF survey date not stated
position_end: 84% of under-5s registered at birth; 66% hold a birth certificate (UNICEF, cited 2026-08-10)

subject: dpi.id
name: Birth registration coverage
milestone: Thirteen communes stated to have a biometric registration system, August 2026
position_start: 83.5 per cent of children under five registered with the civil-status authority, 83.7 per cent of boys and 83.3 per cent of girls
position_end: Digitalisation running in pilot communes with decentralisation to zone level planned, and thirteen communes stated to hold a biometric registration system; no updated national coverage rate is published

subject: dpi.id
name: Civil registration link to the future digital identity
milestone: Country statement to the African registrars general meeting, July 2026
position_start: Paper-based and manual elements persisting, no single national civil-status database, and civil registration not yet interoperable with the future national digital identification system
position_end: Interoperability with health facilities for births and deaths planned with notification through hill chiefs, alongside a national digital identity with a unique identifier and biometrics; the link itself is stated as planned and not built

subject: dpi.id
name: Consumption of the national identity by other systems
milestone: No central national identity database able to support digital know-your-customer
position_end: The national identity system is non-biometric and there is no central national identity database able to support digital know-your-customer; identity is consumed as a document, not as a query
note: a dated statement of absence in a payment-infrastructure assessment, distinct from the payment switch

subject: dpi.id
name: Credential authentication at the border
milestone: Border management system launched at the international airport
position_start: National identity presented as a document rather than authenticated against a register
position_end: Automated reading and verification of passports at the international airport with a direct interconnection to international police databases, announced for progressive extension to other border posts

subject: dpi.id
name: Digital civil registry platform
milestone: Interoperability with health facilities running in 123 facilities, stated by the interior ministry 2026-08-11
position_start: Platform unveiled; every citizen to re-register afresh; family-code amendment required
position_end: Biometric enrolment operating in 13 pilot communes, decentralised to zone level; the civil-registry to health-facility link for birth registration, piloted since 2023 and institutionalised in 2024, now runs in 123 health facilities and has recorded more than 52,000 births. A national unique identifier is planned with fingerprint and facial biometrics
note: the 123-facility and 52,000-birth figures are the interior ministry's own and no coverage denominator is given

subject: dpi.id
name: Domestic appropriation for the biometric identity card
milestone: First domestic-state digital line the wiki tracks for Burundi
position_end: BIF 16.0bn proposed in the draft FY2026/27 budget

subject: dpi.id
name: National production of travel documents
milestone: Production assured wholly by ministry staff since the expiry of the supplier contract
position_end: Travel-document production stated to be assured one hundred per cent by the migration directorate's own staff since the expiry of the contract with a foreign supplier, a new supplier providing consumables only

subject: dpi.pay
name: BurundiPay national instant payment system
milestone: Public launch 23 April 2026; 17 of 78 licensed institutions live by 4 August 2026 (5 commercial banks, 10 microfinance institutions, 2 payment institutions), with integration mandatory for all licensed institutions by 5 September 2026 under a BIF 1m-per-month-of-delay penalty
position_end: Live; 17 institutions in production of 78 licensed (5 commercial banks, 10 microfinance institutions, 2 payment institutions); about 224,000 users and cumulative transaction volume about BIF 4.29bn (4 August 2026); banks, microfinance and mobile money interoperable on ISO 20022 and USSD at ~1,000 transactions per second
note: Africa's 22nd live instant payment system on the launch accounts.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Business-to-business and business-to-government electronic payment
milestone: National instant payment system launched 23 April 2026
position_start: Managers of public funds required to obtain an electronic-billing-machine invoice from suppliers before payment, on pain of a 20 per cent penalty
position_end: A national instant payment system in service providing interoperability between commercial banks, microfinance institutions and payment institutions, over a clearing house, real-time gross settlement and national switch estate the central bank reports on annually

subject: dpi.pay
name: Cash share of digital-payment value
milestone: Central bank Q2 2025 data
position_end: Deposits and withdrawals ~45% of value; ~1.6m of 7.6m mobile wallets active (Q2 2025)

subject: dpi.pay
name: EAC Regional Cross-Border Payment System Master Plan
milestone: Central bank told the regional governors it expects to join by December 2026
position_end: The central bank has told the region's monetary affairs committee it expects to be inside the East African Payment System by December 2026, having migrated its real-time gross settlement infrastructure to the ISO 20022 standard, and has separately begun connecting the domestic banking sector to the COMESA regional payment and settlement system through technical training for local banks, the post office and the central bank
note: a stated expectation rather than a completed accession; no go-live date, participant list or transaction volume is published

subject: dpi.pay
name: Electronic invoicing machines delivered
milestone: Traders report the machines stop with every power cut, 2026-08-12
position_end: Electronic invoicing machines in use but reported by traders in one province to stop working whenever the power does, halting sales and invoice issuance with every outage, with operators of weak literacy or digital skills reported to struggle
note: a provincial account given to the national news agency; no national outage figure, downtime measure or offline-mode provision is published

subject: dpi.pay
name: Government-to-person payment over mobile money
milestone: Beneficiary system connected to several payment providers, January 2026
position_start: Cash transfers of 73,600 BIF paid every two months over recipients' own mobile phones, 72,000 BIF net of withdrawal charges
position_end: The social protection management system connected to several payment providers after migration, with more than a million beneficiary records behind it

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile-money systems interconnected by BurundiPay
milestone: Lumicash, Ecocash, E-noti and Cashtel named as the systems it links
position_end: Lumicash, Ecocash, E-noti and Cashtel interoperable

subject: dpi.pay
name: PAPSS accession
milestone: BRB acceded to the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System; four Burundian banks authorised to participate (as at 4 August 2026)
position_end: Acceded; four Burundian banks authorised to participate in PAPSS
note: AfCFTA Secretariat discussed PAPSS as an implementation instrument during its 3 August 2026 mission to Burundi; the accession date itself is not stated, only that it has occurred by 4 August 2026

subject: dpi.pay
name: Payment switch migration to ISO 20022
milestone: Migration completed by the central bank
position_end: Migrated

subject: dpi.registry
name: 2027 electoral register preparation
milestone: Opposition parties demanded suspension of the electoral commission's preparations
position_end: Under way and contested; no biometric card in use

subject: dpi.registry
name: Electronic land-title register
